Self.Wiki: An item pickup. The treasure places the items of its item lots as a glowing pickup at the treasure part, such as an item corpse or a chest. Taking it awards the lots and sets the lot's Get Item Flag, after which the pickup no longer appears. A chest treasure can't be taken until the chest is opened.

TreasurePartName.Wiki: The part the pickup is placed at, normally an Object (item corpse, chest). For a chest, this is the chest object that is opened. With no part, no pickup appears.

ItemLot1.Wiki: The ItemLotParam row given by the treasure.

ItemLot2.Wiki: A second ItemLotParam row given with the first. Rarely used; -1 for none.

ActionButtonID.Wiki: An ActionButtonParam row for the pickup prompt, or -1 for the default. -1 on every retail treasure.

PickupAnimID.Wiki: The player animation played when taking the pickup. Retail uses 60070 for loose items and corpses and 60090 for chests.

InChest.Wiki: If ON, the item is inside a chest and can't be taken until the chest is opened. Retail chests use this rather than Start Disabled.

StartDisabled.Wiki: If ON, the pickup is placed hidden and can't be taken until something enables it. Only one retail treasure uses it.
